cause_quote: The new catalog-backed builder initialized its choices with `const supported = new Set<OpenAIThinkingLevelId>(["off"]);`, adding Off even when the catalog omitted it.
user_saw: The reasoning picker offered Off for Codex models that could not disable reasoning, and selecting it could leave the model using its default effort.
summary: The OpenAI provider now builds catalog-backed reasoning choices from the advertised efforts and preserves Off when the catalog explicitly supports it.
reasoning: The parent commit used static thinking levels, including Off, and had no catalog-backed policy. PR #98021 introduced the catalog-backed builder with the unconditional Off entry and added tests that expected Off even when the catalog listed only High or supplied an empty list.
